ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 75 percent high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels in the central regions and 25 percent low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated along the trailing edge, lateral tips, and leading edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central zone. Symmetrical dark pigmentation bands define the entire trailing edge and lateral tips. Distinct dark circular mottling/spots are visible on the interior of the left lobe (mid-upper region) and near the median notch on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate acute pixel angle; central convergence of the two lobes is clearly defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, small-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge, presenting as a jagged silhouette against the sea surface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering sharply toward the distal lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, localized low-intensity pixel clusters (dark spots) on the high-intensity white background; one notable circular cluster on the upper-middle left lobe and another adjacent to the median notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, thin, unaligned dark linear pixel disruption (scratch/rake mark) is visible on the upper-left lobe, running diagonally from the trailing edge towards the center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible diagonal linear scratch on the left lobe and multiple small dark circular pigmented spots indicative of previous surface trauma or barnacle attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark 'cap' or thick pigmented border along the trailing edge that terminates in pointed lateral tips.
